title: Teen Numbers Worksheets | Kindergarten Math Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: K.NBT.A.1

Give your learners extra practice with Teen Numbers! This no-prep printable pack has 4 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (7 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Tens and Ones
  • Teen Number Match
  • Listen & Find Teen Numbers
  • 10 and Some More
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Tens and Ones, Teen Number Match, Listen & Find Teen Numbers, 10 and Some More), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Math Bundle and the Mega Bundle.

Terms: one license for one home or one teacher. Please do not share or post publicly. Thank you!
